info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Treasury Balance Sheet Managements-spec
info.description: The Treasury Balance Sheet Management API offers an efficient way to access and retrieve detailed information about the treasury balance sheets within the financial organization. This API allows users to query various balance sheet management data to support financial analysis and reporting. Ideal for finance professionals and developers, this endpoint facilitates strategic decision-making by providing insights into liquidity and asset management. Typical use cases include monitoring treasury positions and preparing regulatory reports.

get.summary: Retrieve the balance sheet management details.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current balance sheet management information for the treasury, including assets, liabilities, and other financial data necessary for effective fiscal analysis and decision-making.

requestBody.description: Request body for fetching balance sheet management details. This request is used to retrieve the current balance sheet management data, including necessary operations.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the balance sheet data.
